connector.name: Kerdos X402 MCP
connector.registryDescription: Crypto market intelligence MCP - pay-per-tool-call in USDC on Base via the x402 protocol.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kerdos-x402-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the singlishman account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: User-supplied EVM private key on Base mainnet. Used solely to sign USDC `transferWithAuthorization` payment payloads via x402. Each tool call costs $0.01-$0.06 USDC.

env.name: KERDOS_X402_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override of the Kerdos x402 endpoint base URL.
